snippet.title: Yashi - Sand Driver - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
This is the reveal trailer of the game Yashi - Sand Driver for Steam.

In an endless desert, you are Yashi, a lone survivor... until this radio signal changes everything. Jump in your van with your faithful coyote, drive across the wastelands, survive the heat, scavenge resources, craft tools, fight the elements & find your way to New Eden in this feel-good road trip.

Wishlist Yashi on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4601370

Music Credit: Rising Sun 2026 by Ende https://ende.app/en/song/13582-rising-sun-2026
